canonical_name: Owl Bio (Aul Bio) / Kyungdong Pharm – AUL009, Xtina™ (ExTenna™)

current_status.stage: Phase 1 IND filed with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (as of ~Sept 2026); human PK/safety data already presented
current_status.partner: Kyungdong Pharmaceutical (lead developer) / Aul Bio (platform provider)
current_status.data_point: Single dose maintained stable blood concentration for 30+ days; suppressed initial burst release, reducing early GI side effects; compatible with 27-gauge ultrafine needle

finding_history.summary: Kyungdong Pharmaceutical and Aul Bio presented a Late-Breaking Abstract at ADA 2026 for AUL009, a once-monthly semaglutide microparticle injection built on Aul Bio's proprietary 'Xtina' (also rendered 'ExTenna™') long-acting delivery platform. Human PK/safety data showed a single dose maintained stable blood concentrations for 30+ days, suppressed initial burst release (reducing early nausea/vomiting risk), and is compatible with a 27-gauge ultrafine needle for reduced injection discomfort. Independently corroborated by multiple other Korean trade outlets covering the same presentation (Dailypharm, Medifonews, TheBioNews).

Kyungdong Pharmaceutical and Aul Bio filed a Phase 1 clinical trial (IND) application with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for AUL009, the once-monthly semaglutide long-acting injectable, to evaluate safety, tolerability, PK, and PD toward establishing dosing strategy for obesity/metabolic disease.
